decisions.reason: It fits the firm's core industrial heat-exchanger and automation business, and a medium-sized German machinery maker would usually allow more than one year for market adoption.

As a web-based engineering tool it is less central to the machinery portfolio and easier to discontinue, but it likely has low upkeep and can support customer acquisition, so it is more likely to be retained for now.

A fouling detection system is closely aligned with the firm's technical process-equipment capabilities, so management would typically continue backing it unless early results were clearly disappointing.
